purpose: Exact-DOI-screened enrichment beyond Waves 1-3, focused on evidence families absent from main and absent from earlier 2026-09-14 Book-enrichment waves.

candidates.title: Enhancing weld line strength in fiber-reinforced recycled polypropylene through gas-assisted push-pull injection molding
candidates.rightsState: Creative Commons open access; verify exact licence variant before reuse
candidates.limitations: Specialist gas-assisted push-pull process; do not generalize settings to conventional moulding.

candidates.title: Applying a new mold temperature control strategy to improve the tensile strength of thin wall products in injection molding processes
candidates.rightsState: CC BY; article states all relevant data are within the manuscript
candidates.limitations: Rotating induction-heated insert system is specialised; local temperatures/timings are case-specific.

candidates.title: Calibration of the set of laser profilers with an application to real time measurement of the injection molded parts geometry
candidates.scale: four profilers; 20 calibration experiments; 780 reference points
candidates.rightsState: open article; industrial component geometry remains company-controlled
candidates.limitations: Measurement capability is installation-specific and does not itself prove process capability.

candidates.title: Elimination of halo gloss transition surface defects on injection-molded parts
candidates.rightsState: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; adapted article material is restricted
candidates.limitations: Material, hot-runner gate and polished tool are specific.

candidates.title: Molding trials and injection phase simulations considering the impact of variable material properties from recyclates on flow front progression
candidates.limitations: Measured trials and simulation must remain distinct; tested property ranges are not generic recyclate limits.

candidates.title: Injection moulding compounders: Integrated processing route for enhanced thermoplastic composite performance?
candidates.rightsState: Creative Commons open access; verify exact licence variant
candidates.limitations: Integrated compounder differs from a conventional reciprocating-screw moulding cell.

candidates.title: Impact of multiple mechanical recycling cycles on the structure and performance of paper fiber-reinforced polypropylene composites
candidates.rightsState: publisher article; verify exact licence before reuse
candidates.limitations: Paper-fibre PP laboratory reprocessing does not represent every post-consumer history.

candidates.title: Rapid Quantitative Assessment of Residual Stress States in PLA Components Enabled by the Combination of Photoelasticity and the Hole Drilling Method
candidates.rightsState: CC BY; underlying data available on request
candidates.limitations: Reported stress magnitudes/depths are case measurements, not design or acceptance limits.

candidates.title: Industrial-Scale Injection Moulding Validation of Recycled Fiber-Reinforced Polypropylene: Processability and Manufacturing Feasibility
candidates.scale: seven industrial companies/sites across Spain and Slovenia with multiple machine and mould families
candidates.limitations: Multi-site feasibility does not establish one transferable process window.

candidates.title: Process-driven thermal optimization of injection molds through rapid tooling with lattice-structured surface cooling channels
candidates.rightsState: publisher article; verify exact reuse terms
candidates.limitations: Rapid-tooling geometry specific; simulation outputs must remain labelled separately.

candidates.title: A comparative study of conformal and traditional cooling system for optimizing molding time and warpage reduction
candidates.rightsState: publisher article; verify final licence before reuse
candidates.limitations: Simulation only; useful for Pareto reasoning, not as measured production evidence.

candidates.title: Cross-Study of Techniques for the Analysis of Deformations Generated in the Injection Molding Process
candidates.rightsState: open MDPI article; verify final licence metadata before derived reuse
candidates.limitations: One HDPE geometry/process study; simulation agreement does not create a generic deformation model.

candidates.title: Applying material jetting to produce prototype injection moulds from medical grade and conventional photopolymers
candidates.rightsState: open article; verify final licence text before reuse
candidates.limitations: Photopolymer prototype inserts are not representative of steel production mould life; observed 40–50-cycle degradation is not a general limit.

candidates.title: Data-driven optimization of moisture content in thermoset transfer moulding: an industrial case study on process stability and scrap reduction
candidates.scale: 1524 parts; 254 cycles; six controlled moisture levels
candidates.limitations: Epoxy thermoset physics differs from thermoplastics; reported moisture window must stay specialist/case-specific.

candidates.title: Quantifying energy consumption variability in injection molding: A meta-regression analysis
candidates.scale: 160 energy-use observations from 15 studies, 20 materials and three machine types
candidates.rightsState: Creative Commons open access; shared Figshare dataset requires separate licence verification
candidates.limitations: Secondary synthesis only; never count as an independent physical moulding experiment.
